# Third-party headers

| file | from | licence |
|---|---|---|
| `stb_truetype.h` | [nothings/stb](https://github.com/nothings/stb) at 0bc88af4 (v1.26) | public domain / MIT (in the file) |
| `earcut.hpp` | [mapbox/earcut.hpp](https://github.com/mapbox/earcut.hpp) at 2fbafada | ISC (`LICENSE-earcut.txt`) |

Both are used by `src/port/text3d.cpp` (font outlines for translated 3D words, and triangulating their faces).
